impact.cashFee: The driver will collect {amount} for the delivery fee from the sender.
impact.codUnchanged: The {amount} collected from the recipient for the goods doesn’t change.
impact.invoice: Invoice {number} is voided; the customer can issue a corrected one.
impact.bulk: Only this shipment changes — not the rest of its bulk booking.

editPrice.audit: The old and new price, the reason, your name and the time are recorded.

blocked.closed: Delivered, cancelled and returned shipments keep the price they were completed at.
blocked.fee_paid: The delivery fee has already been paid. Changing it would need a refund or an extra charge, which ParcelLink can’t record yet.
blocked.fee_collected: The driver has already collected the delivery fee in cash. Changing it would leave their cash records wrong.
blocked.on_statement: This shipment is on a merchant statement. Correct the statement instead.

cancel.title: Cancel this shipment?

consequences.noDriver: It is removed from the dispatch queue.
consequences.customer: The customer is notified that operations cancelled it.
consequences.bulk: Only this shipment is cancelled — not the rest of its bulk booking.

money.feePaid: The delivery fee was paid. Cancelling doesn’t refund it — arrange the refund separately. The payment record is kept.

money.cashExpected: The {amount} the driver was due to collect is no longer expected.

cancel.audit: The reason, your name, the previous status and the time are recorded.
cancel.cancelledRefund: Shipment cancelled. Its delivery fee was paid — arrange the refund.

blocked.picked_up: The parcel has been picked up and is with the driver. The driver must return it to the sender instead.
blocked.delivery_failed: This delivery failed. Mark it returned instead.

cash.title: Driver Cash Reconciliation
cash.intro: What each driver has collected, handed over to ParcelLink, and still owes. Only confirmed remittances reduce a balance; cash still to be collected is shown separately.
cash.pendingQueue: {count, plural, one {# remittance is} other {# remittances are}} waiting for your confirmation. Open a driver to confirm or reject.
cash.empty: No driver has handled cash yet.
cash.pendingNote: {amount} recorded and awaiting a manager’s confirmation (not yet deducted).
cash.nothingAvailable: Everything this driver owes is already recorded and awaiting confirmation.
cash.nothingOwed: This driver doesn’t owe anything right now.

cards.periodNote: Activity counts cash collected and remittances received in the period. The balance above is always today’s.

expected.meaning: Cash due on shipments assigned to the driver and not yet collected: the recipient’s cash on delivery plus the sender’s cash delivery fee. It is not money the driver holds.

collected.meaning: Amounts recorded at the moment the driver confirmed collecting them.

remitted.meaning: Cash handed over by the driver and confirmed by a manager. Pending and rejected remittances are not included.

outstanding.meaning: Collected minus remitted: the cash the driver holds for ParcelLink right now.

pending.meaning: Remittances an operator recorded that a manager hasn’t confirmed yet. They don’t reduce the balance.

filters.datesHint: Dates filter the activity figures (UAE time). Balances are always today’s.
filters.ledgerDatesHint: Dates match when cash was collected (or assigned, if not yet collected) and when a remittance was received.

record.managerHint: As a manager, your remittance is confirmed when you record it.
record.operatorHint: A manager confirms the remittance before it reduces the driver’s balance.
record.donePending: {amount} recorded. It counts once a manager confirms it.

decision.confirmDescription: Confirm that ParcelLink received {amount}. It will reduce the driver’s balance and can’t be undone.
decision.rejectDescription: {amount} will not be counted. The record and your reason are kept.

validation.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero
validation.twoDecimals: Use at most two decimal places
validation.method: Choose how the money was received
validation.date: Enter the date the money was received
validation.rejectReason: Give a reason for rejecting it
validation.moreThanOwed: That’s more than the driver can remit right now

cash.operatorRecordNote: Drivers submit their cash and you confirm it when you count it.

driverDetail.charges: Delivery charges on these shipments: {charges}, of which {cash} is payable in cash. COD due on them: {cod}. Charges are what was billed, not what was collected.
driverDetail.collectedShipments: {count, plural, =0 {No collections} one {From # shipment} other {From # shipments}}
driverDetail.nowScope: Across all periods: cash collected less remittances an operator or manager has confirmed. Unremitted cash carries over from week to week.
driverDetail.pendingNote: {amount} submitted and waiting for confirmation — still outstanding until confirmed.
driverDetail.confirmedNote: {amount} confirmed by operators or managers so far.
driverDetail.expectedNote: Still to collect on undelivered shipments: COD {cod} · delivery fees {fee}. Not in the balance.
